Issaquah Social

Issaquah, WA · Road · Social

Issaquah Social is a road and social group ride in Issaquah, WA. It rolls every Thursday at 11:00 am from Tibbetts Valley Skateboard Park (Oct 1 start). Pace: steady, 12-14 mph; the two posted rides ran 26 to 28 miles, hills climbed at a steady effort with regroups at the top.

For visitors

Free, but sign in on Cascade's site and register for each ride. Helmet and a safety briefing at the start are required.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 11:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 12-14 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Issaquah Social group ride

A Thursday late-morning Cascade free group ride out of Issaquah. The Oct 1 route ran northwest to Bellevue College and Redmond and back on the East Lake Sammamish Trail, with a food stop at mile 16.6. It's a steady, social pace with regroups at the top of the hills.
